name: silo-study
description: Silo Study Desk: 8-month math + physics course. Monorepo: Next.js web, Node/Express/Mongoose API, shared content package.

scripts.seed: npm run content:build && npm run seed -w @silo/api
scripts.dev: npm run content:build && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @silo/api" "npm run dev -w @silo/web"
scripts.build: npm run content:build && npm run build -w @silo/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run start -w @silo/api" "npm run start -w @silo/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @silo/api && npm run typecheck -w @silo/web
